feeds.title: My Life Suckers
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Deva! I make funny videos and music parodies about parenting! This blog gives a humorous way of handling parental pressures, how to deal with everyday struggles and enjoying your life at the same time.

feeds.title: Mommy Shorts » Wit
feeds.description: Parental wit and wisdom from the mind of a mom with two girls. Hii! I am Ilana Wiles. In addition to personal stories, I like to post parenting charts, baby memes and episodes of The Mommy Show, where I interview celebrities at home while I take care of my kids.

feeds.title: Wit and spit up
feeds.description: Covers witty articles about motherhood, inspired by the most adorable tiny humans on the planet, by Jessica, a wife, mother to three beautiful daughters, and proud minivan owner.

feeds.title: Smile When You Say That
feeds.description: To combat my tendency to insult, cuss, and complain in a journal, I have chosen to write in a more public fashion. I hope that knowing other people might read this will encourage me to put a positive spin on whatever freak show is going on in my head.

feeds.title: The Funny Mom Blog
feeds.description: Motherhood is funny. Desiree Eaglin writes real and funny stories, helpful reviews and easy recipes to celebrate motherhood and to make the most fun out of parenting as possible.

feeds.title: What's Up Moms » Laugh
feeds.description: A parenting site that will not put you to sleep. This blog will give you inspiration on how to enjoy your parenthood and a satirical way to enjoy life with your kids.

feeds.title: Mother Humor
feeds.description: Mother Humor is a comedy site for moms lampooning parenthood, pregnancy, family, pop culture, news, funny pictures and videos, and everyday absurdity.

feeds.title: Dude Mom » Real talk
feeds.description: Dude Mom is a humor, lifestyle blog written by the best mom in the world. In her free time, she enjoys losing weight easily, looking like a soap star the moment she rolls out of bed and riding around town on her unicorn.

feeds.title: Mommy Cusses
feeds.description: Sweary parent humor blog with posts that are snarky, sarcastic, honest, relatable, funny, and entertaining. Momming isn't easy, and there's no such thing as a perfect mom. Yet we're bombarded by articles and Instagram tiles that fool us into thinking perfection is par for the course. This is one of those mom lifestyle blogs you can count on to change your view. I'm here to punch unrealistic parenting expectations right in the crotch and give sanctimommies the middle finger.

feeds.title: Bleeping Motherhood
feeds.description: Bleeping Motherhood was invented by 2 moms who believe that laughter is the best medicine. If you choose to laugh, then stay here. If you choose to frown, then take a hike.

feeds.title: One Funny Mother Blog
feeds.description: One Funny Mother is all about Women, Wine, and Laughter. Grab some wine, look around and check out our one-woman show, board game, viral videos or One Funny Mother store.
